text:
monica: Quick coordination — planning to push the routing change (v2 -> combo-fallback) to the canary pool tonight at 18:30 PT. Will be a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 20m pauses. Need an obs owner for smoke checks and dashboard tweaks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devin: I can own smoke checks. Will run through perf + correctness tests at each step. What exact queries should we watch?

monica: thanks @devin. Key panels: per-model p95/p99 latency, token throughput (tokens/s per instance), 5m error rate, and routing mismatch count (requests routed to fallback unexpectedly). Also loosen the alert for host-cpu until we verify load, see below for queries.

ash: I can do the dashboard edits. Which panels need minor layout changes vs new queries?

monica: ash — small layout tweaks for the routing dashboard, add two new panels: (1) routing_mismatch_count by pool, (2) kvcache-hit-rate by model. Everything else is existing.

ash: got it. adding panels now. ETA 40m.

lucy: FYI I've prepped the smoke script and a short prompt set. devin — I'll hand off the curl commands you can use.

lucy: curl smoke example:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"combo-fallback","input":"Summarize: The cat sat on the mat."}'
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate | jq .
```

lucy: quick golden checks: 1) response within 1.2x baseline p95, 2) tokens sensible, 3) no 5xxs, 4) routing header shows pool=canary or fallback as expected.

monica: Add the following PromQL snippets to the panel queries (ash):
```promql
sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m])) by (model, pool)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
sum(rate(redwood_inference_routing_mismatch_total[5m])) by (pool)
```

devin: Perfect. I'll run the smoke harness at each pause. If timings look bad at 25% -> hold and escalate. Who's on pager for infra tonight if we need to revert?

monica: @sylvia on-call tonight for infra, @devin you're observability lead, and @ash owns dashboard changes. If we need to rollback, plan is: immediate abort of the staged rollout and run platform rollback. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback (follow steps 1-4).

sylvia: Acknowledged. I have permissions to cut the rollout or scale down pods. Also will watch autoscaler and GPU utilization.

alert-bot: Heads-up: temporary suppression available for the host-cpu-high alert. Use `/alerts suppress host-cpu-high 2h --reason "canary warmup"` if you want to avoid noisy pages during the first 10m.

monica: Let's suppress for the first 30m of the rollout; devin will unsuppress if metrics look stable. ash — please add an annotation on the dashboard panels noting the suppression window.

ash: will do. Also adding a small note on the panel: "Canary rollout 18:30 PT — host-cpu alert suppressed for first 30m"

devin: timeline check: 18:30 start -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m pause) -> 100% (20m). I'll post quick readouts after each stage.

monica: thanks. final checklist: ash (dash edits + annotation), devin (smoke script + readouts), lucy (smoke data + curl examples), sylvia (rollback/pager), monica (coord + gating). If anyone needs to swap roles ping asap. :white_check_mark:

lucy: copying smoke harness into #eng-oncall for visibility once it's uploaded.

devin: first readout will include: p95,p99, tokens/s, 5xx count, routing_mismatch_count. If any delta >10% from baseline for p95 or >0.5% 5xx increase -> rollback.

monica: everyone clear?

ash: clear.

sylvia: clear.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: routing-service v2->combo-fallback canary at 1718207000 (18:30 PT). Staged rollout config: [5%,25%,100%], pause windows configured.

monica: perfect — thanks all. I'll start the rollout at the scheduled time and post here at each gate.
